conflicting_oracle.policy: Fresh original table and current Clarity agree on 35 percent resistance. Retain the conflict; do not use the legacy 40 percent tier.

primary_context.claim: Historical Lightfall mod migration changed weapon-archetype mods to weapon-damage-type mods; current exact factors come from the original Compendium and Clarity.

algorithm.copies: Count currently equipped matching-element sources on the defender, clamped to 0..3. Every socket contributes one source; no cached charge or buff.
algorithm.sampling: Only completed ADS. Match the defending held weapon origin tags, not the incoming attack element.
algorithm.composition: incoming angle * Stability * Health * one armor factor * other perk factors. All matching copies expose the same combined tier to the MAX armor stage, never one multiplier per copy.

policies: The three-socket chest reference uses the independent equipment container. Replacing armor changes the next hit immediately without restarting an unchanged No Distractions source.

Out-of-band fourth copies saturate at tier three; the reference chest has exactly three required choices and rejects unknown/fourth choices. Armor energy budget and unlock/cost constraints are not yet modeled.
Completed ADS is the same explicit Chorus sampling boundary as Health/No Distractions. Exact original transition interpolation remains uncalibrated.

Source tags describe the currently held weapon element. Alternate damage-type weapons require their actual mode-to-origin provider; this batch does not infer an element from the incoming hit or invent Osmosis/Permeability behavior.

Harmonic descriptions are preserved in the source record but the variant is not installed. Current subclass/Super element selection, Prismatic semantics and mixed harmonic/elemental copy accounting remain to implement.
Base incoming flinch, reference rifle health/damage/ammo/rate/ADS inputs remain synthetic. Formal catalogue, equip UI/HUD, world restart, recoil recovery and visual shake remain incomplete.
